name: tallyo
description: Self-hosted personal finance tracker for your household — transactions, budgets, net worth, and portfolio via Plaid, SimpleFIN, and crypto wallets. Rust + React PWA, single binary, SQLite.

paragraphs: Self-hosted personal finance tracker for your household. Supports Desktop and mobile PWA.
Live demo — the full UI running on fictional data in your browser (no backend, changes reset on reload)
features: 💰 All-in-one spending and net worth tracker — transactions, recurring charges, cash flow, budgets, investment portfolio, and historical net worth in one app
🏦 Bank integrations with Plaid and SimpleFIN — automatic transaction, balance, and holdings sync from thousands of institutions
📈 Yahoo Finance pricing and asset classification — live security quotes plus portfolio breakdowns by composition, Morningstar category/group, and sector
🪙 Crypto wallet tracking with DeBank — paste an EVM address to track token balances across chains; no API key required
🎯 Budget tracking — monthly budgets vs. actuals with history and copy-forward

whatItDoes.text: Self-hosted personal finance tracker for your household. Supports Desktop and mobile PWA.

requirements.text: 🪙 Crypto wallet tracking with DeBank — paste an EVM address to track token balances across chains; no API key required
🔐 Secure Protection — built-in OAuth 2.1 + PKCE authorization server with Google Sign-In, email OTP/magic links, passkeys, and role-based access control.

Anyone in the US (and Canada, though only USD accounts are supported) can now signup for a free Plaid account and get 10 free logins/connections, which should be enough for most households to track their finances (note: you can configure more credentials in the app if other household members also sign up for their own).
Can also use an Authorization header with X-Api-Key:$MASTERPASSWORD if relying solely on Master Password signin without Oauth
